name: Vent collar (ceiling light slit rim)

joins.pivot: bottom centre (z = 0 = the flat underside, the face seen from the room below)
joins.placement: set into a ceiling / AN03 vault opening with the underside flush or 0.1-0.3 m proud of the ceiling surface; the slot (about 2.7 x 1.2 m clear, through) must line up with the hole in the ceiling
joins.clear_slot_m: approx 2.7 x 1.2 (bean shape, waist on +Y side)
joins.light: no beam/glass/plants modelled; light is a separate source in Unity

notes: thick uneven closed earth ring around an elongated through-slot: crooked top height, chamfered inner bottom edge, bulging outer face, flat underside.
